assessment: The frozen source explicitly reports the final 10-M_sun black-hole density-profile fit rho_bh = 4.95e8 (r/0.0033 pc)^(-1.75) M_sun pc^-3 and states its fitted radial interval as approximately 10^-4 to 0.01 pc. The card preserves the reported black-hole branch, coefficients, units, radius control, fitted-profile applicability, and line locators. Treating the printed fitted central values and the stated approximate interval endpoints as the deterministic operational relation is appropriate; no observed density or uncertainty is invented.

issues.detail: The source describes both the density law as an approximate fit and the lower radial endpoint with an approximation sign; the card uses the printed central fit and 0.0001 pc as the operational lower endpoint without claiming additional precision.

controls.definition: Radius coordinate at which the final black-hole density profile is evaluated.
controls.name: r

applicability.statement: This is a power-law fit that approximates the final relaxed density profile.
The modeled black-hole component consists of 10 M_sun black holes.

readouts.definition: Mass density of the black-hole component in the fitted final background profile.
